County in east central Nebraska and Northwestern Fillmore County in
south central Nebraska...

* WHEN...Until 100 PM CDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is occurring.

north of Grafton was at 13.0 feet, which was 2.0 feet above minor
flood stage of 11.0 feet. As a result, fairly widespread flooding
of pastures and fields immediately adjacent to the river
continues, including downstream through the McCool Junction area

time.

West Fork Big Blue River.

McCool Junction, and rural areas along the West Fork Big Blue
River both upstream and downstream of McCool Junction.

Big Blue River Near Barneston affecting Gage County.

.This update reflects a slight decrease in the forecasted river
crest.

* WHAT...River levels may approach minor flood stage.

* WHERE...Big Blue River near Barneston.

* WHEN...Until Monday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 18.0 feet, Rural lowlands begin to flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 5:00 AM CDT Saturday the stage was 15.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 20.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 18.8 feet
tomorrow evening.
- Flood stage is 20.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 18.4
feet on 06/02/2010.

properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Additional information is available at water.noaa.gov.

The next statement will be issued this afternoon at 530 PM CDT.
